about: Curated, sourced model facts for the Meridian Models tab (cc_engine/models.py). Hand-edited. Every number names its source; anything not stated in a source stays out (the tab shows it blank / n/a). A provider config (cordis.patch.yml contextWindow) wins over these values for context windows.
